nodes.label: Who Mae Ann is
nodes.content: Mae Ann Bodiongan is an Industrial Engineer based in the Philippines who combines process improvement with AI and workflow automation. She understands processes, finds inefficiencies, redesigns workflows, and uses AI, automation, databases and digital systems where they add value. See [[Process Improvement]], [[AI & Workflow Automation]] and [[Solar Proposal System]].

nodes.label: Focus areas
nodes.content: Industrial Engineering (process improvement, operations, Lean), Automation (n8n, AI workflows, business automation), Systems (Supabase, web apps, databases), and operations and client workflow automation. She is especially interested in automated client journeys from inquiry and onboarding to proposal generation, follow-up and operational tracking.

nodes.label: Approach
nodes.content: Seven steps: 01 Understand the business or operational process. 02 Map inputs, activities, decisions, bottlenecks and outputs. 03 Improve by removing unnecessary steps and redesigning. 04 Design the improved workflow and information flow. 05 Automate with AI, n8n, APIs and databases where they add value. 06 Validate logic and outputs. 07 Document the workflow, controls and system.

nodes.label: Solar Proposal System
nodes.content: AI-Enabled Solar Proposal and Client Workflow System (Industrial Engineering x AI Automation x Client Workflow Design). Problem: manual repeated client information gathering, separate engineering calculation steps, slow proposal preparation, fragmented project data. Solution: structured client intake, validated engineering workflow, AI-assisted guidance (Gemini / Google AI Studio), automated proposal process and centralized data in Supabase, deployed on Vercel. Mae Ann's role: industrial engineering, process design, project coordination, automation and AI integration, system development. nodes.label: Solar case study workflow
nodes.content: The [[Solar Proposal System]] replaced a manual flow (client inquiry, manual information collection in Excel, manual engineering check, manual recommendation, manual proposal, manual email) with a structured one: client inquiry, structured intake, validation, central database, engineering logic, AI assistance, proposal generation, client workflow. Before: repetitive manual entry, fragmented records, manual calculations, repeated communication, separate systems, difficult tracking. After: structured client intake, centralized data, standardized calculations, automated workflow, AI assistance, easier project tracking. Architecture: web app, business logic and automation, Gemini, Supabase, email and Google Workspace.

nodes.label: Inquiry handling SOP
nodes.content: Mae Ann wrote an SOP for how website inquiries are handled. Purpose: standardize how inquiries are captured, acknowledged, routed and tracked. Trigger: a visitor submits a validated inquiry form. Process: validate, store, notify, acknowledge, schedule follow-up, maintain status. Exceptions: spam or invalid data is rejected, backend failures are logged, and a direct-email fallback is provided. The automation lab flow is: website inquiry, Supabase, n8n, acknowledgement email, owner notification, follow-up workflow.
